title: The DNS implementation must protect the authenticity of communications sessions for dynamic updates.
check_content:
Review the DNS server configuration to determine if communication sessions for dynamic updates are provided authenticity protection. 

If communications sessions do not employ authenticity protections, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the DNS server to employ mechanisms to protect the authenticity of communications sessions for dynamic updates.
VulnDiscussion: DNS is a fundamental network service that is prone to various attacks, such as cache poisoning and man-in-the middle attacks. If communication sessions are not provided appropriate validity protections, such as the employment of DNSSEC, the authenticity of the data cannot be guaranteed.
